### Reference: fns

#### `fillClaims`

function · `import { fillClaims } from '@harness/sdk'`

A call's claims from its fn's templates (`FnDecl.parallelClaims`) and its args, each once, in the order declared.

@example fillClaims(['file:{args.path}'], { path: 'src/app.ts' })   // → ['file:src/app.ts']
fillClaims(['row:{args.ids}'], { ids: [1, 2] })            // → ['row:1', 'row:2']
fillClaims(['dir:{args.cwd|.}'], {})                       // → ['dir:.']

```ts
function fillClaims(templates: readonly string[], args: Json): string[];
```

Refers to: [`Json`](context:fs/authoring.core-types.primitives-ts#core-json).

#### `ClaimsRequest`

const, type · `import { ClaimsRequest } from '@harness/sdk'`

What the hub asks a fn's system for a call's claims with (`claims` on the system link), before the call is a run.

```ts
type ClaimsRequest = {
  fn: string;
  args: z.core.util.JSONType;
  user: {
    id: string;
    name: string;
    email: string;
    role: "admin" | "member";
    groups: {
      id: string;
      name: string;
    }[];
    timeZone: string;
    locale: string;
  };
  caller: string;
  session?: string | undefined;
};
```

Refers to: [`Json`](context:fs/authoring.core-types.primitives-ts#core-json), [`RunId`](context:fs/authoring.core-types.primitives-ts#core-runid), [`SessionId`](context:fs/authoring.core-types.primitives-ts#core-sessionid), [`UserInfo`](context:fs/authoring.core-types.run-ts#core-userinfo).

#### `ClaimsInput`

type · `import { ClaimsInput } from '@harness/sdk'`

What a fn's `parallelClaims` option takes: the templates as written, each checked against its args.

```ts
type ClaimsInput<A, C extends readonly string[]> = C & { readonly [K in keyof C]: C[K] extends string ? CheckedClaim<C[K], A> : C[K] };
```

#### `CheckedClaim`

type · `import { CheckedClaim } from '@harness/sdk'`

A claim template as written, or an error naming the token it may not use.

```ts
type CheckedClaim<S extends string, A> =
[Exclude<TokensOf<S>, ClaimTokens<A>>] extends [never] ? S : `Unknown claim token {${Exclude<TokensOf<S>, ClaimTokens<A>>}}`;
```

type · `import { ClaimTokens } from '@harness/sdk'`

#### `ToolClaims`

type · `import { ToolClaims } from '@harness/sdk'`

The claims of one tool call. An empty list claims nothing and conflicts
with nothing (except a call that runs alone, see `ALL_CLAIMS`).

```ts
type ToolClaims = readonly string[];
```

#### `ClaimsCtx`

interface · `import { ClaimsCtx } from '@harness/sdk'`

What a fn's `claims(args, ctx)` gets: the system context, the person whose turn made the call, the agent run that
made it and its chat. The call isn't a run yet, so it has no run of its own.

```ts
interface ClaimsCtx<Cfg = unknown, O extends Own = Own> extends SystemCtx<Cfg, O> {
  readonly user: UserInfo;
  /** The agent run that made the call. */
  readonly caller: RunId;
  readonly session: SessionId | undefined;
}
```

Refers to: [`RunId`](context:fs/authoring.core-types.primitives-ts#core-runid), [`SessionId`](context:fs/authoring.core-types.primitives-ts#core-sessionid), [`UserInfo`](context:fs/authoring.core-types.run-ts#core-userinfo).

#### `ALL_CLAIMS`

const · `import { ALL_CLAIMS } from '@harness/sdk/server'`

A claim that conflicts with every other call in the batch, whatever that
call claims or whether it claims anything: the call runs alone. Earlier
calls finish before it starts, and later calls wait for it.

```ts
const ALL_CLAIMS: "*";
```

#### `FnCheckInput`

type · `import { FnCheckInput } from '@harness/sdk'`

A fn's args check as `fn()` takes it: `true` for a check that calls nothing, or `{ calls }` naming the deps it calls,
each one of the fn's deps whose mode is `read` (the hub refuses any other call, and any that would wait for approval).

```ts
type FnCheckInput<D extends Deps> = true | { readonly calls: readonly (keyof D & string)[] };
```

#### `FnCheckTypes`

interface · `import { FnCheckTypes } from '@harness/sdk'`

What the type system knows of a fn's args check: the keys of the deps it may call (`never` for none).

```ts
interface FnCheckTypes {
  calls: string;
}
```

#### `CheckTypesOf`

type · `import { CheckTypesOf } from '@harness/sdk'`

The check types of what `fn({ check })` was given; `never` when it has no check.

```ts
type CheckTypesOf<Ck> =
Ck extends { readonly calls: readonly (infer K extends string)[] } ? { calls: K } :
Ck extends true ? { calls: never } :
never;
```

#### `CheckCtx`

interface · `import { CheckCtx } from '@harness/sdk'`

What a fn's args check gets (`fn({ check })`, `check(args, ctx)`): the run waiting to be decided and whom it is for,
the system's config, named types, its log, and callers for only the deps its check declares (`calls`), each a read.
Nothing here changes anything, spends or asks anyone: a check reads what the args name and says what is wrong.
`signal` aborts at `deadline`, when the hub stops waiting and lets the call go on unchecked.

```ts
check: async (args, ctx) => {
  const target = await ctx.fns.getFn({ fn: args.fn });
  return target.available ? [] : [{ path: 'fn', message: `${args.fn} can't run now: pick another fn.` }];
},
```

```ts
interface CheckCtx<D extends Deps = Deps, Cfg = unknown> {
  readonly system: string;
  readonly config: Cfg;
  /** The queued run whose args are checked; the check's calls are its children. */
  readonly run: RunId;
  /** The person the run is for: the deps answer as them. */
  readonly user: UserInfo;
  /** The deps the check declares, called as the run (each a `read` fn; any other call is refused). */
  readonly fns: Callers<D>;
  readonly types: Types;
  readonly log: Log;
  /** When the hub stops waiting for the answer. */
  readonly deadline: Timestamp;
  readonly signal: AbortSignal;
}
```

Refers to: [`RunId`](context:fs/authoring.core-types.primitives-ts#core-runid), [`Timestamp`](context:fs/authoring.core-types.primitives-ts#core-timestamp), [`UserInfo`](context:fs/authoring.core-types.run-ts#core-userinfo).

#### `CheckImpl`

type · `import { CheckImpl } from '@harness/sdk'`

A fn's args check in its implementation: required exactly when it declares `check` (its ctx calls only the deps the
check names), absent otherwise; optional for a fn known only at runtime.

```ts
type CheckImpl<T extends FnTypes, Cfg = unknown> =
T extends { readonly check: infer C }
  ? [C] extends [never]
    ? { check?: never }
    : C extends FnCheckTypes ? { check(args: T['args'], ctx: CheckCtx<Pick<T['deps'], C['calls'] & keyof T['deps']>, Cfg>): Promise<CheckProblems> } : never
  : { check?(args: T['args'], ctx: CheckCtx<T['deps'], Cfg>): Promise<CheckProblems> };
```

#### `MissingExamplesError`

class · `import { MissingExamplesError } from '@harness/sdk'`

A contract with static fns that declare no example: the build and `serve` refuse it, naming each.

```ts

  readonly name: "MissingExamplesError";
  readonly system: string;
  readonly fns: readonly string[];
  constructor(system: string, fns: readonly string[]);
}
```
